ui.title: Almost God
ui.tagline: Show the impossible. Make it a law.
ui.plan_resolution: Law recorded. Put it to use.
ui.level_unavailable: The stage could not be opened
character.CH01.name: Professor Felix
character.CH02.name: Plum
character.CH03.name: Marfa
character.CH04.name: Semyon
character.CH05.name: Nika
character.CH06.name: Lada
character.CH07.name: Roza
character.CH08.name: Hugo
character.CH09.name: Caramel
level.L01.title: The First Crossing
level.L01.objective: Help Marfa cross the canal to her bakery.
level.L01.intro: Marfa: “The bridge is broken, and I have the bakery key.” Professor: “Show the impossible. The Atlas can make it real.” The float supports only the stone. Marfa and her basket weigh two units together.
level.L01.joke: Felix checks for a second support. There isn't one.
level.L01.success: Marfa reached her door with the basket. She can open the bakery now. The water supported the stone after the float was removed.
level.L01.hint1: Marfa must see the stone while its support stays hidden.
level.L01.hint2: A tall screen hides the stone too. Try folding its top.
level.L01.hint3: Place the screen in front of the float and fold it. Demonstrate, make it a law, then remove the float.
level.L02.title: The Floating Anchor
level.L02.objective: Moor the boat to the wooden bollard and unload the crate.
level.L02.intro: Marfa: “The crossing worked. Now the anchor floats too.” The stone-law page is already applied at this pier; no new demonstration is needed.
level.L02.joke: Marfa: 'A front-row ticket is no guarantee of a first-class view.'
level.L02.success: A rope tied to the wooden bollard holds the boat, and the crate reached the landing. Wood kept its ordinary properties.
level.L02.hint1: The stone law affects the anchor too.
level.L02.hint3: Tie the boat to the wooden bollard before unloading.
level.L03.title: Every Angle Counts
level.L03.objective: Demonstrate the effect from both views and deliver the parcel.
level.L03.intro: Semyon: “I am not doubting. I am checking the side view.” These two rigid screens do not fold; move them. Both views must show the stone without its float. Once the law is recorded, the stone becomes a crossing support.
level.L03.joke: Semyon: “The stone is visible from this side too. Its support is hidden.”
level.L03.success: The parcel reached the far bank. Semyon checked both views, and the real crossing carried the load.
level.L03.hint1: Semyon will inspect more than the front.
level.L03.hint2: Check his second stop and the ray to the float.
level.L03.hint3: Place the second rigid screen on the right side of the stage to hide the float from the second view.
level.L04.title: A Windy Experiment
level.L04.objective: Secure the screen, record the law and cross the canal.
level.L04.intro: Plum can barely hold his satchel in the wind. Professor: “A good experiment starts with a stable setup.” Two clamps are available before the demonstration.
level.L04.joke: Plum opens a tiny umbrella. The wind closes it for him.
level.L04.success: The screen held through the gust. The professor crossed on the stone after the float was removed.
level.L04.hint1: The gust moves an unsecured screen during the demonstration.
level.L04.hint3: Position the screen and attach both clamps before the demonstration.
level.L05.title: A Clear View
level.L05.objective: Give all three observers a clear view and deliver the crate.
level.L05.intro: One helper is sitting behind the ticket booth. The booth hides the stone. The Atlas needs a visible result, so first check the helper’s position.
level.L05.joke: Marfa: 'The anchor became a float. A promotion, apparently.'
level.L05.success: The crate is delivered. Every observer saw the stone, and the hidden support is no longer needed.
level.L05.hint1: One spectator can only see the ticket booth.
level.L05.hint3: Move the spectator from behind the booth to the empty seat on the right, then perform again.
level.L06.title: Separate Crossings
level.L06.objective: Guide Caramel across and deliver both crates.
level.L06.intro: Caramel heads toward the medium stone. The small stone carries only one extra mass unit. This stage already uses the stone law.
level.L06.joke: Caramel tries to eat the ticket. The ticket is wooden. The ticket wins.
level.L06.success: Caramel and both crates reached the far bank. Separate crossings kept the load within the supports’ capacities.
level.L06.hint1: Caramel weighs more than one crate. Stone capacity is shown separately.
level.L06.hint2: The medium stone carries Caramel. The small stone carries one towed crate.
level.L06.hint3: Send Caramel over the main crossing. Then tow each crate separately over the small stone.
level.L07.title: The Halfway Island
level.L07.objective: Reach the island, then the far pier.
level.L07.intro: Professor: “The island is a place for the next step.” From the island, the released near support can be moved farther ahead.
level.L07.joke: Felix: 'A short bridge. Fortunately, it knows how to continue.'
level.L07.success: The professor reached the far pier. The island provided a safe place to rearrange the second part of the route.
level.L07.hint1: The island is a safe stopping point.
level.L07.hint2: A support behind you can help with the next part.
level.L07.hint3: Reach the island, then move the released near stone to the reachable far slot.
level.L08.title: Two Hidden Methods
level.L08.objective: Remove both supports and complete the crossing.
level.L08.intro: Nika: “I see the float. What is that thread?” The Atlas checks every visible method. One screen may not be enough.
level.L08.joke: Nika: 'They found one secret. Good thing you packed a spare.'
level.L08.success: The float and thread are removed, and the stone carried the real crossing. The test did not depend on anyone forgetting the method.
level.L08.hint1: The warning points to another mechanism.
level.L08.hint3: Remove the safety thread before the show, or hide it behind a separate screen.
level.L09.title: The Full Inspection
level.L09.objective: Complete Semyon’s inspection and deliver the cargo.
level.L09.intro: Semyon: “I need the full view, not the first applause.” The record is ready only after continuous observation from every required position.
level.L09.joke: Semyon finished the inspection, the law is recorded and the cargo is delivered. A brief first impression was not enough to seal the page.
level.L09.success: Semyon finished the inspection, the law is recorded and the cargo is delivered. A brief first impression was not enough to seal the page.
level.L09.hint1: The second inspection point matters as much as the first.
level.L09.hint2: The record becomes ready after continuous clear observation from both points.
level.L09.hint3: Hide the float with both screens and wait for the full inspection. Then make the result a law.
level.L10.title: A Working Crossing
level.L10.objective: Deliver the cargo and Caramel while keeping the boat moored.
level.L10.intro: Marfa checks the list: boat, crate, Caramel. The law will help everyone, but the stone anchor will stop holding the boat after sealing.
level.L10.joke: Marfa lists Felix as 'temporarily permanent miracle'.
level.L10.success: The cargo and Caramel are delivered, and the boat stayed at the pier. The wooden mooring held after the stone changed.
level.L10.hint1: The law lifts the stone anchor along with other stone objects.
level.L10.hint2: The wooden bollard remains a reliable mooring.
level.L10.hint3: Attach the mooring rope to the bollard before recording the law. Transport the cargo and Caramel separately.
level.L11.title: Cold Fire
level.L11.objective: Show water freezing and cross the ice passage.
level.L11.intro: Lada: “Fire should warm things. Dessert might disagree.” To record the new law, water must freeze during observation beside a visible flame.
level.L11.joke: Lada: 'Our fire has lost its professional warmth.'
level.L11.success: The professor crossed the ice. After the Atlas record, the real brazier cools the passage; the stage flame does not.
level.L11.hint1: The water must change during the show.
level.L11.hint2: The flame and water must remain visible.
level.L11.hint3: Start with liquid water and place the hidden cold pack beneath the bowl.
level.L12.title: Two Dishes, Two Temperatures
level.L12.objective: Freeze the dessert, protect the bread and deliver both dishes.
level.L12.intro: Lada: “Ice cream should be cold. Bread should not.” The law is already active, but a closed insulated box protects the bread.
level.L12.joke: Lada relabels an unsuccessful pie as 'festive sorbet'.
level.L12.success: The dessert is frozen, the bread is intact and both are delivered. The box was closed before cooling and stayed beside the bread during loading.
level.L12.hint2: A closed insulated box blocks the cold.
level.L12.hint3: Protect the bread, freeze the dessert, then load both into the delivery crate.
level.L13.title: Ice and Liquid Water
level.L13.objective: Freeze the passage while keeping the right-hand pool liquid.
level.L13.intro: Lada: “Only the passage needs ice.” The right-hand control pool must stay liquid. The law affects both real braziers.
level.L13.joke: The professor crossed the ice. The right-hand pool stayed liquid: the two areas have different temperatures.
level.L13.success: The professor crossed the ice. The right-hand pool stayed liquid: the two areas have different temperatures.
level.L13.hint1: Both zones freeze for the same reason.
level.L13.hint2: The law affects every real fire.
level.L13.hint3: Screen the cooling path to the right-hand pool or move the second brazier away.
level.L14.title: Cold from Every Angle
level.L14.objective: Show freezing from both views and open the passage.
level.L14.intro: Semyon: “I will check the bowl from both sides.” Hiding the method is not enough: the water surface and its change must remain visible.
level.L14.success: Semyon completed both observations. The law is recorded, and the professor crossed the ice.
level.L14.hint1: The method must stay hidden from every inspection point.
level.L14.hint2: The bowl surface must remain visible above the screens.
level.L14.hint3: Position both screens to hide the cold pack from both sides. Run the full demonstration.
level.L15.title: Heat Without Fire
level.L15.objective: Thaw the right-hand pool while preserving the main ice passage.
level.L15.intro: Lada: “The brazier cools now. What about a heated stone?” The Atlas changed fire sources; stored heat in a stone is a different kind of source.
level.L15.joke: The right-hand pool thawed while the main passage stayed frozen. The water in the two areas now has different temperatures.
level.L15.success: The right-hand pool thawed while the main passage stayed frozen. The water in the two areas now has different temperatures.
level.L15.hint2: A heated stone keeps its thermal class.
level.L15.hint3: Block cooling at the right-hand pool and warm its water with the heated stone.
level.L16.title: The Steam Experiment
level.L16.objective: Record the law before the steam clears and cross the passage.
level.L16.intro: Professor: “Steam may hide the instrument, but must not hide the result.” The dense veil lasts only through the first observation interval.
level.L16.joke: Felix: 'The secret evaporated. The result stayed.'
level.L16.success: The Atlas recorded the observed result, and the passage is open. After sealing, steam no longer needs to hide the instrument.
level.L16.hint1: Steam only needs to last until sealing.
level.L16.hint2: Allow a full continuous observation interval.
level.L16.hint3: Hide only the mechanism ray with steam, or use a permanent screen.
level.L17.title: Two Atlas Pages
level.L17.objective: Keep the floating stone, add cold fire and complete the route.
level.L17.intro: Nika holds the Atlas open: “There is room for another record.” The stone law is already active here; the new experiment adds a different law.
level.L17.joke: Roza asks: 'One impossibility was no longer sufficient?'
level.L17.success: Both records are active, and the professor crossed the stone and ice sections. Adding the second page preserved the first support.
level.L17.hint1: The second law fits in the empty slot.
level.L17.hint3: Seal the cold-fire law in the free slot, then run the whole route.
level.L18.title: Free the Channel
level.L18.objective: Thaw the boat channel while preserving the pedestrian support.
level.L18.intro: Professor: “Ice helps walkers but blocks the boat.” Two laws are active; the stone support can be preserved.
level.L18.joke: The boat completed its route, and the stone remained a stable support. The water required by the boat route became liquid.
level.L18.success: The boat completed its route, and the stone remained a stable support. The water required by the boat route became liquid.
level.L18.hint1: The boat needs liquid water in its own zone.
level.L18.hint2: Stop the cooling and add independent heat.
level.L18.hint3: Put the screen between the oven and the boat, then bring the heated stone closer.
level.L19.title: Restore the Oven’s Heat
level.L19.objective: Revoke cold fire and deliver cargo across the stone support.
level.L19.intro: Lada is ready to bake bread. Ordinary fire will thaw the ice crossing, so the professor must first prepare a support that does not depend on temperature.
level.L19.joke: Lada: 'Firing the fire was a heated decision. Well, the opposite.'
level.L19.success: Fire warms again, the water is liquid and the cargo crossed on stone. The replacement crossing was ready before cold fire was revoked.
level.L19.hint1: Ordinary fire will thaw the ice.
level.L19.hint2: Prepare a support that does not depend on ice.
level.L19.hint3: Build the stone crossing before revoking the cold-fire law.
level.L20.title: A Feast for the Square
level.L20.objective: Protect the bread, freeze the dessert and deliver the feast.
level.L20.intro: Lada: “One delivery needs two temperature rules.” The stone crossing is available. The bread needs a closed insulated box before the cold demonstration.
level.L20.joke: Lada's menu: 'Miracles served with a side dish.'
level.L20.success: Both dishes are delivered: the dessert is frozen and the bread intact. The festival delivery kept its crossing support.
level.L20.hint1: The feast needs two different temperature results.
level.L20.hint2: Source positions and insulation remain your choices.
level.L20.hint3: Protect the bread, freeze the dessert before loading, then deliver both across the stone support.
level.L21.title: Load-Bearing Paper
level.L21.objective: Record paper’s strength, remove the frame and deliver the load.
level.L21.intro: Hugo: “A sheet on a frame is not a bridge yet.” The professor will show a real load on paper; the hidden frame helps only before the Atlas record.
level.L21.joke: Felix: 'It works on paper. For once, literally.'
level.L21.success: The frame is removed, and the load crossed the paper between two anchors. The law changed the sheet’s strength; it still needed its anchors.
level.L21.hint1: The paper must actually carry the weight.
level.L21.hint2: The frame is the method; contact with the weight is the result.
level.L21.hint3: Mount the paper at both anchors, screen the frame and use the hoist to lower the test load onto the paper.
level.L22.title: A Gate for Caramel
level.L22.objective: Guide Caramel around the barrier and preserve the paper.
level.L22.intro: Strong paper has become a strong barrier. Caramel cannot tear through it, but the wooden gate still has an ordinary handle.
level.L22.joke: Caramel went around the barrier, and the paper sheet is intact. The law did not need to change for the wooden gate to open.
level.L22.success: Caramel went around the barrier, and the paper sheet is intact. The law did not need to change for the wooden gate to open.
level.L22.hint1: Strong paper makes a strong barrier too.
level.L22.hint2: The gate has another material and an ordinary handle.
level.L22.hint3: Open the wooden gate and choose the detour.
level.L23.title: A Fire-Safe Archive
level.L23.objective: Deliver the load while preserving the paper bridge.
level.L23.intro: Hugo: “Strong does not mean fireproof.” A heat screen is available; adding cold fire is another possible approach.
level.L23.joke: The load crossed the intact span. Heat was blocked by a screen or changed by another law.
level.L23.success: The load crossed the intact span. Heat was blocked by a screen or changed by another law.
level.L23.hint1: Strength does not make paper fireproof.
level.L23.hint2: Change the fire or block its thermal path.
level.L23.hint3: Add the cold-fire law, or put the screen between the oven and paper.
level.L24.title: A Light Bridge, a Careful Load
level.L24.objective: Deliver the load over paper without overloading its stone supports.
level.L24.intro: The professor checks two limits: the sheet’s strength and the stones’ capacity. The paper law changes only the first.
level.L24.joke: The load is delivered, the paper intact and the floating supports within capacity. The heavy test load was removed before movement.
level.L24.success: The load is delivered, the paper intact and the floating supports within capacity. The heavy test load was removed before movement.
level.L24.hint1: A stronger sheet does not increase the stone supports’ capacity.
level.L24.hint2: The heavy test load is needed only for the record.
level.L24.hint3: Anchor the paper at both ends. After recording, remove the test load and frame, then deliver the working load.
level.L25.title: The Span Inspection
level.L25.objective: Complete both of Roza’s views and deliver the load.
level.L25.intro: Roza walks around the test stand. Every view needs a visible loaded sheet and a hidden frame. Knowing the method does not replace checking the geometry.
level.L25.joke: Roza: 'I am checking the reverse side of your approval.'
level.L25.success: Roza completed the inspection, the frame is removed and the load delivered. Both views showed the same observable result.
level.L25.hint1: Roza walks around the stand, so one view is not enough.
level.L25.hint2: The screens must hide the frame while leaving the sheet and load visible.
level.L25.hint3: Prepare the sheet, frame and load. Position both screens, demonstrate, then remove the frame before delivery.
level.L26.title: Two Slots, Three Laws
level.L26.objective: Deliver both loads while deliberately replacing one law.
level.L26.intro: Professor: “There are no free pages. Finish the tasks that depend on them first.” The small parcel must leave the water before replacing the stone law.
level.L26.joke: Felix: 'May I have a third miracle?' Roza: 'Certainly. In place of one of the other two.'
level.L26.success: Both deliveries are complete and the paper intact. The record was replaced after the needed supports and heat protection were prepared.
level.L26.hint1: A new law does not replace an old one automatically.
level.L26.hint2: Prepare for whichever law you remove.
level.L26.hint3: Finish the water delivery before replacing the stone law, or shield the fire before replacing the cold-fire law.
level.L27.title: Strength Does Not Stop Heat
level.L27.objective: Deliver the load while preserving the paper span and flags.
level.L27.intro: Hugo spots fire near the paper flags. The strong-paper law is already active; now the dangerous heating must be stopped.
level.L27.joke: The load is delivered, and the paper span and flags are intact. Dangerous heating no longer threatens the paper.
level.L27.success: The load is delivered, and the paper span and flags are intact. Dangerous heating no longer threatens the paper.
level.L27.hint1: A new miracle is optional here.
level.L27.hint2: Moving the oven changes where its heat reaches.
level.L27.hint3: Move the oven to the far slot, or screen off its thermal path.
level.L28.title: A Separate Demonstration
level.L28.objective: Prepare the support, demonstrate paper strength and deliver the load.
level.L28.intro: Roza: “A floating stone does not prove paper strength.” The stone support is still in water: move it to its dry mount before testing the sheet separately.
level.L28.joke: Roza: 'Your impossible is in the ordinary register.'
level.L28.success: The support reached its dry mount. The paper passed its own demonstration and carried the real load after the frame was removed.
level.L28.hint1: The floating support is not yet in the span’s dry mount.
level.L28.hint2: The paper demonstration needs both mounted anchors and a real load.
level.L28.hint3: Move the left support to its dry mount. Prepare the paper demonstration and hide the frame from both sides.
level.L29.title: The Ice Must Form
level.L29.objective: Show liquid water turning to ice and complete the route.
level.L29.intro: Hugo: “I prepared the sample.” Professor: “Then we must restore its starting state.” Nobody observed the old ice forming.
level.L29.joke: Hugo: 'It was a prepared miracle.' Nika: 'It also needs to happen.'
level.L29.success: The water thawed, then froze during a new observation. The Atlas recorded the transition, and the professor completed the route.
level.L29.hint1: Existing ice does not show water changing beside a flame.
level.L29.hint2: The heated stone can restore the sample to liquid water.
level.L29.hint3: Warm the bowl with the stone and run time. Once thawed, remove the stone and demonstrate fresh freezing with the cold pack hidden.
level.L30.title: The Square of New Laws
level.L30.objective: Complete both deliveries using three laws in sequence.
level.L30.intro: Professor: “A law is useful when it helps someone.” The small load crosses on stone first, cold prepares the passage, and strong paper carries the final load.
level.L30.joke: Felix removes the last thread. Plum takes it for his scarf.
level.L30.success: Both deliveries are complete and the paper intact. You used three laws in sequence with at most two active records. The residents can get back to work.
level.L30.hint1: Three laws need not be active at once.
level.L30.hint2: Cargo delivered to dry land no longer needs to float.
level.L30.hint3: Deliver first, freeze the passage, then replace the stone law with paper strength and complete the final crossing.

ui.ordinary_world: The world is ordinary for now
ui.observation_help: The result must stay visible. Statuses show whether observation is complete.
ui.proof_accepted: The demonstration worked. The Atlas makes the result a law only after a separate seal.
ui.wait_water: Waiting for freezing or thawing. Everyone is staying in a safe place.
ui.world_acts: The world follows the new rules. Stop time after the routes are complete.
ui.vision_help: Green rays show visible results. A ray to the mechanism reveals the trick. Choose an empty seat to move a spectator.
ui.place_help: Tap a marked destination. The button below opens actions for this prop.
ui.revoke_help: Support properties will change. Delivered cargo stays where it is. Undo remains free.
ui.level_select_help: Every experiment can be repeated for free.
ui.credits_text:
Felix, Plum, Marfa, Semyon, Nika, Lada, Roza, Hugo and Caramel thank you.

This world now knows that even the impossible begins with a well-planned trick.

Music and illustrations were created for this game.

reason.WRONG_PHASE: Finish the current action or return to the plan.

reason.ROUTE_START_UNREACHABLE: The route start is out of reach. Prepare an approach.
reason.CARRIER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: That carrier already has another route.
reason.PAYLOAD_NOT_LOADED: Load every part of the delivery beside the crate first.
reason.HOIST_REQUIRED: The heavy load needs a hoist.
reason.HOIST_CAPACITY: The hoist cannot lift this weight.
reason.HOIST_CANNOT_REACH: The hoist cannot reach that destination.
reason.OVER_CAPACITY: The combined load exceeds the support. Split the delivery.
reason.MISSING_FLOATING_BRIDGE: A support is missing or no longer works.
reason.NOT_ENOUGH_WITNESSES: Observation is incomplete from some required views. Check visibility and observation time.
reason.ROUTE_IN_PROGRESS: The route is unfinished. You can undo the whole run for free.
reason.GOALS_INCOMPLETE: The plan did not finish every goal in time.
reason.FIXED_INSPECTION_PATH: The inspector follows a fixed viewing route.
reason.INVALID_REPLACEMENT: Choose one of the two active laws.
reason.NO_PROOF: Show the audience valid proof first.
reason.NO_CANDIDATE: Choose the next miracle in the plan.
reason.LAW_NOT_ACTIVE: First make the result a law in the Atlas. The float is still supporting the stone.
reason.TOW_ROPE_TOO_SHORT: The rope cannot reach the end of this route.
reason.INCOMPATIBLE_ATTACHMENT: These objects cannot be attached together.
reason.ROUTE_STATE_BLOCKED: The route is blocked. Check gates and mooring.
reason.IMMOVABLE: This object is fixed. Choose another action.
reason.ENTITY_REMOVED: The object was removed. Undo brings it back.
reason.GENERIC: This action is unavailable. Check the plan or undo.

level.L01.next_story: The same law lifted a stone anchor. At the next pier, the boat needs another mooring.
level.L01.resolution_tip: The water supports the stone and its load. Remove the float, then guide Marfa across.
level.L02.next_story: Semyon is waiting for another parcel and wants to inspect the demonstration from both sides.
level.L02.resolution_tip: Attach the rope to the bollard. Then assign the crate an unloading route and run the plan.
level.L03.next_story: Wind is rising over the open landing. The next demonstration needs secure equipment.
level.L03.resolution_tip: After recording the law, remove the float, position the crossing stone and deliver the parcel.
level.L03.resolution_hint1: The law is active. Check whether the parcel has a support along its route.
level.L03.resolution_hint2: The demonstration position and crossing position are different places for the stone.
level.L03.resolution_hint3: Move the stone to ‘Crossing support’, then assign or retry the parcel route.
level.L04.next_story: Helpers are gathering by the ticket booth. The result is not visible from every seat.
level.L04.plan_tip: Secure both screen legs before the demonstration.
level.L04.resolution_tip: After the demonstration, remove the float and move the stone to the crossing. Then assign the professor’s route.
level.L05.next_story: Caramel and two crates are waiting at the crossing. The capacities of the supports now matter.
level.L05.plan_tip: Check the helper behind the booth and the empty seat nearby.
level.L05.resolution_tip: After recording the law, remove the float. The large stone can carry the professor and crate.
level.L05.success_title: The crate reached the far bank!
level.L06.next_story: A wider canal with an island lies ahead. One stone arrangement will not reach the finish.
level.L06.plan_tip: Compare passenger mass with support capacity.
level.L06.resolution_tip: Caramel uses the medium stone. Tow each crate separately across the small stone.
level.L07.next_story: Nika noticed an extra safety thread in the next setup. Both supports need attention.
level.L07.plan_tip: Build the route to the island and check your reach.
level.L07.resolution_tip: Reach the island first. Then move the released stone to the far position and assign the second route.
level.L08.next_story: Semyon wants to finish his inspection before the Atlas seals the page.
level.L08.plan_tip: Inspect the float and safety thread separately.
level.L08.resolution_tip: Remove every support after recording the law. Then move the stone onto the route and guide the professor.
level.L09.next_story: The district’s final crossing combines the boat, cargo and Caramel.
level.L09.plan_tip: Do not restart while the inspector is still changing views.
level.L09.resolution_tip: Wait for the complete inspection, record the law and prepare the real cargo crossing.
level.L10.next_story: Lada calls from the festival square. The next experiment will change what fire does.
level.L10.plan_tip: Prepare the mooring before changing the stone anchor.
level.L10.resolution_tip: Moor the boat to wood. After recording the law, transport the cargo and Caramel separately.
level.L11.next_story: Lada now needs cold dessert and warm bread at the same time.
level.L11.resolution_tip: After recording the law, the real brazier freezes the passage. Assign the route and wait for safe ice.
level.L12.next_story: On the next stage, freeze the passage while keeping the right-hand control pool liquid.
level.L12.plan_tip: Protect the bread before starting the cooling step.
level.L12.resolution_tip: Freeze the dessert, then load both dishes and the closed box at their delivery positions.
level.L13.next_story: Semyon wants to inspect the next cold experiment from the other side.
level.L13.plan_tip: Check the second brazier’s effect on the right-hand pool.
level.L13.resolution_tip: Protect the right-hand pool from cooling. The main passage must freeze.
level.L14.next_story: At the next stage, the right-hand pool has frozen. A heated stone can thaw it while preserving the ice passage.
level.L14.plan_tip: Check the cold-pack view from the second inspection point.
level.L14.resolution_tip: After recording, use the real brazier to freeze the passage and assign the professor’s route.
level.L15.next_story: The next setup hides its method with steam. It will not last forever.
level.L15.plan_tip: Block cooling at the right-hand pool and add another heat source.
level.L15.resolution_tip: Protect the right-hand pool from the cold brazier and bring the heated stone closer. Run time so it can thaw.
level.L16.next_story: Stones already float on the next stage. Cold fire must be added while keeping the first record.
level.L16.plan_tip: Compare the observation interval with the steam duration.
level.L16.resolution_tip: After sealing, wait for ice and guide the professor. A permanent screen is another way to prepare the setup.
level.L17.next_story: Ice blocks the next boat channel. Only that zone’s temperature needs to change.
level.L17.plan_tip: The second record goes into the Atlas’s empty slot.
level.L17.resolution_tip: Prepare the stone and cold demonstration. Keep both laws and assign the complete route.
level.L18.next_story: The festival kitchen needs ordinary fire again. A crossing must be prepared first.
level.L18.plan_tip: Block cooling at the channel, then warm it with the stone.
level.L18.resolution_tip: Run the thawing step. Once the channel is liquid, assign the boat’s route and start movement.
level.L19.next_story: Lada is preparing a festival delivery: warm bread and cold dessert will travel together.
level.L19.plan_tip: Create the stone support before revoking the cold law.
level.L19.resolution_tip: Record the stone law and prepare the crossing. Then revoke cold fire and deliver the cargo.
level.L20.next_story: Hugo is building a paper workshop. The Atlas will need a new experiment with a real test load.
level.L20.plan_tip: Close the bread in its box before the cold experiment.
level.L20.resolution_tip: Protect the bread, add the cold law, freeze the dessert and load both dishes for delivery.
level.L21.next_story: Caramel has met a strong paper barrier. An ordinary wooden gate stands nearby.
level.L21.resolution_tip: After recording, remove the frame, return the load to the hoist and assign the paper-span route.
level.L22.next_story: A brazier is burning near the archive’s paper. Strength does not make a sheet fireproof.
level.L22.plan_tip: Inspect the wooden gate beside the strong paper.
level.L22.resolution_tip: Open the gate and assign Caramel the detour. Leave the paper barrier intact.
level.L23.next_story: The next paper span rests on two floating stones. Their load limit matters too.
level.L23.plan_tip: Check the heat path from the brazier to the paper span.
level.L23.resolution_tip: Block heating with the screen or add cold fire. Only then run the load’s route.
level.L24.next_story: Roza will inspect the next span from both sides. The frame must be hidden, not the load.
level.L24.plan_tip: Keep paper strength separate from support capacity.
level.L24.resolution_tip: Remove the test load and frame after recording. Then carry the working load over the anchored sheet.
level.L25.next_story: Both Atlas slots are occupied. The next span requires choosing which law is no longer needed.
level.L25.plan_tip: Inspect the frame from both of Roza’s viewpoints.
level.L25.resolution_tip: After sealing, remove the frame and return the load to the start. Assign the paper route.
level.L26.next_story: The next stand needs no new record: moving the brazier can be enough.
level.L26.plan_tip: Deliver the small parcel onto dry land first.
level.L26.resolution_tip: Take the first load off the water. Then record paper strength, choose a safe replacement and deliver the second load.
level.L27.next_story: Roza has a test load ready. A new certificate needs a separate experiment with paper itself.
level.L27.plan_tip: Try changing the heat source’s position.
level.L27.resolution_tip: Move the brazier away or block its heat with a screen. Then run the delivery.
level.L27.success_title: The span and flags are safe!
level.L28.next_story: Hugo brought an already frozen sample. The Atlas needs to observe the change, not just finished ice.
level.L28.plan_tip: Move the left support from the water to its dry mount.
level.L28.resolution_tip: Secure both anchors, run the paper test from both views and remove the frame before delivery.
level.L29.next_story: Everyone is gathering in the square. The final task combines stone, cold and paper with only two active slots.
level.L29.plan_tip: First thaw the old sample with an independent heat source.
level.L29.resolution_tip: Warm the bowl with the stone and run time. Move the warm stone away, then demonstrate fresh freezing.
level.L30.next_story: All 30 tasks can be replayed from the Atlas. Try other valid solutions and compare their consequences.
level.L30.plan_tip: Finish each dependent delivery before replacing its law.
level.L30.resolution_tip: Deliver the first load on stone, create the cold passage, then record paper strength and choose a safe replacement.

law.M01.description: Water supports separate stone objects and loads within their capacity. Buildings and terrain do not change.
law.M02.description: Real fire sources cool within their radius. Heat screens block the effect; a heated stone retains ordinary heat.
law.M03.description: Paper withstands heavy loads but still needs anchors and still burns in ordinary fire.
reason.METHOD_VISIBLE: The method is visible. Adjust the screen and demonstrate again.
reason.RESULT_OBSCURED: The screen hides the result. The object itself must stay visible.
ui.atlas_rule: Show the impossible from outside, and the Atlas can make it real.
ui.atlas_scope: Each stage has its own page. Active records are shown when the stage begins.
reason.SAILING_REQUIRES_WATER: The boat needs an unbroken route through water. Choose a sailing route.
ui.placement_invalid: This object cannot be placed here. Choose a highlighted location or cancel placement.
ui.plan_no_routes: No routes have been assigned yet.
ui.mooring_not_secure: Attached, but the boat is not held securely
ui.support_wrong_slot: Support is away from the crossing
ui.support_over_capacity: Support cannot carry the combined load
